test_Pool_map: test the Pool class by mapping a function over a range of integers
test_Pool_apply_async: test the Pool apply_async method to evaluate a function asynchronously with a timeout
test_Pool_imap: test the Pool imap method to iterate over mapped results in order
test_Pool_imap_unordered: test the Pool imap_unordered method to iterate over mapped results in any order
test_Pool_terminate_join: test the Pool terminate and join methods to gracefully shut down worker threads
